## Change

Explain the design problem or package issue and the resulting skill behavior.

## Validation

List commands and observed results. Distinguish automated checks, hand-written examples and actual model or host trials.

## Content and compatibility

Confirm new skill text is original wording, host-neutral, and keeps the six lens sections. Note lens, report-format or manifest changes and any unfinished work. Update HANDOFF.md when project state changes.
